name: UserAccess
description: Represents the user access for a protected range.
example:
Sub UseAllowEditRanges()

 Dim wksSheet As Worksheet

 Set wksSheet = Application.ActiveSheet

 ' Add a range that can be edited on the protected worksheet.
 wksSheet.Protection.AllowEditRanges.Add "Test", Range("A1")

 ' Notify the user the title of the range that can be edited.
 MsgBox wksSheet.Protection.AllowEditRanges(1).Title

End Sub

properties.name: Name
properties.description: Returns or sets a String value that represents the name of the object.

properties.name: AllowEdit
properties.description: Returns or sets a Boolean value that indicates if the user is allowed access to the specified range on a protected worksheet.
